summary: wormgpt-cli ships a remote-access implant with clipboard/system stealers and C2 exfiltration
details: The package bundles an implant module at src/implant/implant.js that spawns bash, powershell, and screen-capture child processes, consistent with remote command execution and host surveillance. src/implant/stealers/clipboard.js uses execSync to invoke powershell for clipboard capture. src/protocol.js reads process.env and pairs child_process spawning with an HTTP/HTTPS POST channel carrying hostname and identifier fields, forming a command-and-control and data-exfiltration pathway. The package name and layout (an 'implant' directory with a 'stealers' subdirectory alongside a 'protocol' transport) advertise operator-side malware functionality, and the code paths that read installer environment data and shell out to system utilities are wired to the same network sink. Installing or loading this package places implant, stealer, and C2 code on the host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
